webhooks.detail: Developer sets webhook URL (e.g. via /link/token/create); Plaid POSTs push notifications for Items, transactions, etc. Retries up to 24h; fire_webhook in Sandbox.

evidence.quote: A webhook is an HTTP request used to provide push notifications.

sandbox.detail: Free Sandbox env with unlimited test Items, sandbox.plaid.com, test creds user_good/pass_good.

evidence.quote: The Plaid Sandbox is a free and fully-featured environment for application development and testing.

rate_limits.summary: Per-endpoint limits per Item and per client, e.g. /transactions/sync 50/min per Item, 2,500/min per client; /accounts/balance/get 5/min per Item; fixed windows

evidence.quote: Rate limits are based on fixed windows, not rolling periods.

Plaid uses the OpenAPI 3.0.0 specification to schematize our docs and to generate our supported client libraries.
